title: TesseraQL decision tables v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL shared decision documents (decisions/*.yml): named decision tables a route references from its 'decide:' block with 'use:'. Documented in decision-tables.md.

decisions.description: Named decision tables. Each declares its contract (typed inputs and outputs, hit and miss policies) and rows; how a route wires the inputs (params:) stays at the reference.

inputs.description: Typed inputs by name; each row cell constrains one of these.

domain.description: Field domain reference declaring the input's type.

match.description: How row cells compare against this input: eq (default, equality; empty cell = wildcard), between (inclusive range), in (membership in a small fixed set), bool.

outputs.description: Typed outputs by name; every row sets all of them.

domain.description: Field domain reference declaring the output's type.

enum.description: The output's full value space, enabling consumption-side exhaustiveness lints.

hitPolicy.description: first (default): authored order resolves. unique: more than one conditional match is an error, and overlapping rows fail the build.

onMiss.description: error (default): a lookup no row matches raises TQL-DECISION-4721. default: the trailing row without when: answers.

rows.description: The authored rows, resolved in order. A row is the conjunction of its when: cells (absent cell = wildcard); a trailing row without when: is the default.

when.description: Cells by input name: a scalar (eq/bool), a range ('>= 10000', '5..10', a number), or a list (in).

out.description: The outputs this row sets — exactly the declared outputs.
